node.title: Re: first steps with Mojolicious::Lite
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I unfortunately don't have the time to dig into this in detail right now, so for now just a few short comments: I posted an example Mojo app with login support [id://11114043|here] (which I expanded on a bit [id://11114542|here]), it shows the use of under as suggested by the AM - I also strongly recommend you refactor your authentication code out of the handlers, that'll make for a better design. Also, don't use Basic Authentication, at least use Digest Authentication; there's [mod://Mojolicious::Plugin::DigestAuth] but I haven't tried this myself yet. More of my Mojo examples are on [id://830550|my scratchpad].
